name: lp_diagonal_block
description: LP encoded as diagonal SDP block (block_sizes=[-5], 5 nonneg variables). max x1+2*x2 s.t. x1+x2<=4, x1<=3, x2<=3, x1,x2>=0 (slacks s1,s2,s3). Optimal vertex (x1,x2)=(1,3), obj=7. Tests LP-as-diagonal-block handling.
reference_method: Exact closed form: LP vertex enumeration, unique optimal vertex (1,3) with obj=1+2*3=7 (integer).
